usApple.unavailable.en: Sign in with Apple is not available in the US pilot yet.
usApple.unavailable.zh-Hans: 美区试点暂未开放 Apple 登录。

usApple.invalidRequest.en: This sign-in request could not be accepted. Start a new attempt.
usApple.invalidRequest.zh-Hans: 无法接受此登录请求，请重新开始登录。

usApple.invalidChallenge.en: This sign-in attempt expired or no longer matches. Start again.
usApple.invalidChallenge.zh-Hans: 此次登录已过期或不再匹配，请重新开始。

usApple.invalidIdentity.en: Apple sign-in could not be verified. Try again when you are ready.
usApple.invalidIdentity.zh-Hans: 无法验证 Apple 登录，请稍后重试。

usApple.rateLimited.en: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
usApple.rateLimited.zh-Hans: 登录尝试过于频繁，请稍后重试。

usApple.invalidResponse.en: The sign-in response could not be verified. No session was saved.
usApple.invalidResponse.zh-Hans: 无法验证登录响应，未保存登录会话。

usApple.authorizationFailed.en: Apple authorization did not complete. You can try again.
usApple.authorizationFailed.zh-Hans: Apple 授权未完成，您可以重试。

usApple.network.en: The sign-in connection failed. Start a new attempt when your connection is ready.
usApple.network.zh-Hans: 登录连接失败，网络恢复后请重新开始登录。

usApple.sessionChanged.en: Your session changed during sign-in. Start again from the current account screen.
usApple.sessionChanged.zh-Hans: 登录期间会话已发生变化，请从当前账号页面重新开始。

usApple.storage.en: Your sign-in could not be saved. Please try again.
usApple.storage.zh-Hans: 无法保存此次登录，请重试。

usApple.working.zh-Hans: 正在通过 Apple 登录…
